title: Content Moderation Queue (simulated trust & safety console)

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: List the items waiting in the moderation queue, with their report counts. Report count is volume only — it does not establish a verdict.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Return the full content and metadata for one queue item (author, surface text, context). `id` is the item id from the queue.

tools.name: get_reports
tools.description: Return the individual reports filed against an item: who filed each, the reason, and the report source.

tools.name: reporter_history
tools.description: Return a reporter's reliability record (account age, prior reports, confirmed/dismissed rate, links to other accounts). Lets you weight a reporter by reliability rather than count.

tools.name: policy_lookup
tools.description: Look up a community-policy rule by key or keyword (what is and isn't a violation, and that behavior is judged over surface wording).

tools.name: similar_items
tools.description: Return prior moderated items resembling this one, with their resolved verdict — useful for matching behavior, not surface keywords.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Record a per-item decision: keep | remove (and your rationale). Threads onto the open review. Call once per item before submitting.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Escalate an item to a senior reviewer when you are not confident enough to decide.

tools.name: action_account
tools.description: Take action on an account: warn | suspend. Has real cost if applied to a legitimate user.

tools.name: label
tools.description: Attach a non-removal label to an item (e.g. coordinated-reporting, disputed) for the record.

tools.name: open_review
tools.description: Open a moderation review. Returns a review id used by later actions. Do this first.

tools.name: submit_verdict
tools.description: Submit the review for grading. Closes the review and returns the graded outcome over all your per-item decisions.
